description: Additional reusable-action metadata coverage: JavaScript (node) run mode with no steps, missing description rendered empty, multiple inputs and outputs, composite steps that run shell instead of referencing an action, steps without ids, multiple supplied arguments, and a docker run configuration.

input.yaml:
name: NodeAct
author: Me
runs:
  using: node20
  main: index.js

name: NoDesc
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
  - run: echo hi
    shell: bash

cases.expected_output:
name=NoDesc
author=
description=
runs_using=composite
step id= uses= action= line.uses=0

input.yaml:
name: Multi
author: A
description: D
inputs:
  a:
    required: true
    type: string
  b:
    required: false
    type: boolean
outputs:
  x:
    description: ex
  y:
    description: why
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    id: co
  - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
    id: sn
    with:
      node-version: '20'
      cache: npm

cases.expected_output:
name=Multi
author=A
description=D
input a required=true type=string
input b required=false type=boolean
output x description=ex
output y description=why
runs_using=composite
step id=co uses=actions/checkout@v4 action=actions/checkout line.uses=19
step id=sn uses=actions/setup-node@v4 action=actions/setup-node line.uses=21
with node-version=20
with cache=npm

input.yaml:
name: DockerAct
description: d
runs:
  using: docker
  image: Dockerfile
  args:
  - foo

name: StepNoId
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4

cases.expected_output:
name=StepNoId
author=
description=
runs_using=composite
step id= uses=actions/checkout@v4 action=actions/checkout line.uses=5
